concepts.def: The duty to care for others in society
Economy run by private profit and wages
Belief in shared wealth and responsibility
Social divisions based on wealth and status
Drama that teaches a moral lesson

walkthroughs.body_html:
Set in 1912, written in 1945.

Priestley wrote post-war Britain a message: don't go back to Edwardian capitalism. Build a fairer, socialist society.

Social responsibility, capitalism vs socialism, class, gender, age and time.

Almost every essay will pull on at least one of these.

Each Birling represents something. Mr Birling: capitalist greed. Sheila: hopeful young generation. Eric: guilty young man. Mrs Birling: cold class snobbery.

The Inspector exposes them all.
